title: Carved Checkerboard Wedding Band in 14K Gold
descriptionHtml:
The Carved Checkerboard Wedding Band is a 5mm men's wedding band in 14K or 18K yellow, white, or rose gold, from $1,500. A crisp checkerboard motif is carved across the center of this band, each tiny square catching light at a slightly different angle so the surface shifts as the hand moves. Bright polished rails frame the pattern and keep the look tailored rather than busy.

Specifications

Band Width 5mm (custom widths by request)
Pattern Carved Checkerboard
Finish Carved center, polished edges
Metal Type 14K or 18K yellow, white, or rose gold
Ring Sizes 8.5 to 13

Choose your metal color

Made to order in 14K or 18K yellow, white, or rose gold. The photograph shows one metal color; every style is cut in all of them. Choose your color at checkout, or message us and we will send a rendering in your color before we cut.

14K or 18K: which should you choose?

14K gold is 58.3% pure and alloyed with harder metals, which makes it more scratch resistant and the better choice for anyone who works with their hands. 18K is 75% pure, noticeably warmer and deeper in color, and heavier on the finger. It is softer, so it marks more readily over time. On a carved band the extra depth of color in 18K makes the pattern read with more contrast. Both are made to the same tolerances here; the difference is character and durability, not quality.

seo.title: Carved Checkerboard Wedding Band | 14K & 18K Gold
seo.description: Hand-finished checkerboard wedding band in 14K or 18K gold. 5mm, made to order in yellow, white, or rose gold. Custom widths available.
